summary: Diagnosis: at the CP2 wall the agent holds D 1.5 s (an air U-turn toward the goal) and dives into the fail; the human flies straight ~1 s more to a ramp. Built --noise-tau (AR(1)-correlated sampling noise, per-decision distribution/log-prob unchanged). Arm 1 (warm incumbent + --noise-tau 0.5, 750M->925M on a 70k fps box): 27.90 at 901M (CP2 death point crept 500 u west / 190 u up; no CP2 crossing); survived setbacks up to 2.6 units in training, but the policy collapses its own entropy (yaw sigma halved, kl 0.03->0.39). Arm 2 running: arm 1's weights + --race-ratchet (detours free). ckpt is 24M steps after the best eval.
